# Charlie Health

> > Virtual intensive outpatient programs (IOP) for mental health, substance use disorders, and eating disorders across children, teens, and adults with insurance coverage including Medicaid and TRICARE.

Charlie Health provides specialized virtual mental health treatment through intensive outpatient programming, serving diverse populations with affirming care for LGBTQIA+ individuals, neurodivergent clients, military/veterans, and those with trauma. The platform emphasizes flexible, family-centered therapy delivered through group and individual sessions with strong clinical outcomes.

## Key Topics

- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Virtual Mental Health Treatment
- Family Therapy
- Substance Use Disorder Treatment
- Eating Disorder Treatment
- Group Therapy
- LGBTQIA+ Affirming Care
- Neurodivergent-Affirming Treatment
- Telehealth/Virtual Therapy
- Insurance Coverage (Medicaid, TRICARE, UnitedHealthcare, Cigna)
- Trauma & PTSD Treatment
- Maternal Mental Health
- Adolescent Mental Health
- Behavioral Health

## Core Programs

- [Charlie Health Home](https://www.charliehealth.com): Virtual IOP for mental health, substance use, and eating disorder treatment.
- [Mental Health IOP](https://www.charliehealth.com/mental-health): Specialized mental health IOP program with flexible virtual therapy sessions.
- [Substance Use Disorder Treatment](https://www.charliehealth.com/substance-use-disorder): Substance use disorder IOP treatment with insurance coverage including Medicaid.
- [How It Works](https://www.charliehealth.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide to Charlie Health intake process and program enrollment.

## Specialized Treatment Programs

- [Trauma & PTSD Treatment](https://www.charliehealth.com/intensive-outpatient-iop/personalized-trauma-treatment): Specialized virtual IOP for trauma and PTSD treatment.
- [LGBTQIA+ Affirming IOP](https://www.charliehealth.com/intensive-outpatient-iop/lgbtqia): Affirming virtual IOP for LGBTQIA+ individuals across all ages.
- [Neurodivergent-Affirming IOP](https://www.charliehealth.com/intensive-outpatient-iop/neurodivergent): Neurodivergent-affirming virtual IOP for autism, ADHD, and related conditions.
- [Maternal Mental Health Program](https://www.charliehealth.com/intensive-outpatient-iop/maternal-mental-health): Virtual IOP for perinatal mood and anxiety disorders in new parents.

## Treatment by Age Group

- [Virtual Treatment for Children](https://www.charliehealth.com/who-we-serve/children): Virtual IOP treatment for children ages 8-12 with family therapy.
- [Virtual Treatment for Teens](https://www.charliehealth.com/who-we-serve/teens): Virtual IOP for teens with family therapy and adolescent-specific care.
- [Virtual Treatment for Adults](https://www.charliehealth.com/who-we-serve/adults): Virtual IOP for adults with group and family therapy options.
- [Virtual IOP for Military & Veterans](https://www.charliehealth.com/who-we-serve/military-and-veterans): Virtual IOP for military and veterans with TRICARE coverage.
